meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: PDCD4 binds the mTORC2 subunit Rictor through three basic residues, which stops mTORC2 from assembling properly and lowers its kinase activity.
data.mechanism_beginner: PDCD4 grabs Rictor and keeps mTORC2 from working.
data.boundary: Human NSCLC cell lines and mouse xenografts; not shown in normal tissue. Single study.
data.note: 2026-10-10: Interaction type complex-disassembly -> complex-assembly. WANG2026B: PDCD4 binding to Rictor 'disrupted mTORC2 complex assembly'; it prevents formation rather than taking apart existing complexes. Same convention as RAPA-MTORC2 (audit A10). Sign stays 'inhibits'.
